fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Dade County school funding and retrenchment, Miami street-lighting costs and public utilities, and local policing and public safety administration. Coverage also addresses industrial development versus tourism promotion, Miami Chamber of Commerce finances, and public health concerns regarding milk inspection and disease. Additional content includes society/entertainment columns, local rumors and political discussion in the 1928 campaign season, and advertisements for local businesses and venues in Miami, Miami Beach, and Coral Gables.
